prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='rf', seasonality_champion='ONLY_CWT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: Multiple models achieve perfect trend correlation (1.0), with rf selected as trend champion. ONLY_CWT_rf leads in seasonal correlation (0.6248), while CWT_rf achieves the lowest overall RMSE (256.36). High model disagreement (rmse_spread_ratio=51.13) and seasonality variance warrant STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition-aware combination.
